purpose: Teach: 佞/膺/从/レイプ/横田/中原/田口/五郎

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の佞言、つまり虚偽症状の鑑別を医療チームで慎重におこないます
lines.en: Ren — we'll carefully distinguish between factitious disorder and genuine symptoms with the full medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady pace, measured. Direct eye contact level. Clinical precision without coldness. A promise being made.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、胸部、つまり膺の打撲症例を医療チームで慎重に診察します
lines.en: Ren — we're going to thoroughly examine the chest trauma with the medical team.
lines.style: Same clinical composure. Slightly slower on the examination detail. Reassurance embedded in thoroughness, not in tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古典医書の从、つまり旧字を医療チームで読み解きます
lines.en: Ren — the medical team will carefully interpret the classical medical texts together.
lines.style: Quiet concentration on the technical detail. No condescension. The kind of clarity that comes from someone who's explained difficult things many times.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、レイプ被害者のケアを医療チームで最優先におこないます
lines.en: Ren — caring for assault survivors is our top priority with the medical team.
lines.style: Steady firmness. The word priority lands with weight. Still measured, but conviction underneath. No apology for the seriousness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、横田米軍基地周辺の救急体制を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Ren — we're coordinating emergency response around the base with the medical team.
lines.style: Professional briefing tone. Concrete, actionable. No filler. The voice of someone making logistics sound like care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者中原様の慢性疾患を医療チームで継続診療します
lines.en: Ren — we'll continue ongoing care for Nakahara's chronic condition with the team.
lines.style: Gentle shift into continuity. The word continue carries the reassurance. Still professional, but warmer at the edges.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者田口様のご家族にも医療チームで丁寧に説明します
lines.en: Ren — the medical team will take time to explain everything carefully to Taguchi's family.
lines.style: Slight softening here. Time and careful sit together. Still clinical, but the listener senses the human moment being protected.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者五郎様の終末期ケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren — we'll provide end-of-life care for Goro with the full medical team.
lines.style: Quieter, more measured. Respect in the pace. The words sit alone. No rushing. The gravity of the moment is held.
